name: Beaconed for WooCommerce
author: Beaconed AI

sections.description:
AI doesn’t pick the best product. It picks the one it can read.

ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and AI Overviews are already sending shoppers to stores – but they can only recommend what they can actually parse. Thin titles, missing structured data, generic descriptions? Skipped. Doesn’t matter how good the product actually is.

Beaconed scans your WooCommerce catalog for exactly what those tools read – titles, descriptions, SEO metadata, structured data, alt text – scores how discoverable each product is, and generates the fixes.

Nothing publishes without you. Every change gets reviewed and approved in the Beaconed app first, including anything written to your SEO plugin’s fields. Auto-publish is there if you want it; it’s just opt-in, not the default.

How it works

  1. Connect your store to your Beaconed account from the plugin settings.
  2. Beaconed scores your product listings and suggests AI-generated improvements.
  3. Review and approve optimizations in the Beaconed app.
  4. Approved changes are written back into WooCommerce automatically.

What gets optimized

  • Product titles and descriptions
  • SEO titles, meta descriptions, and focus keywords (via your active SEO plugin)
  • Structured product data

Beaconed works alongside your SEO plugin, not instead of it — Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, Squirrly SEO, The SEO Framework, and SmartCrawl are all supported.

Privacy and your data

Beaconed sends product data (titles, descriptions, SEO metadata, image URLs and alt text) to the hosted Beaconed platform (https://beaconed.ai) for scoring and AI generation — when you connect, when you run an optimization, and via an hourly heartbeat carrying plugin/WordPress/WooCommerce version info. A scoped API key is issued per site when you connect, and is revoked when you uninstall the plugin. See our terms of service at https://beaconed.ai/terms and privacy policy at https://beaconed.ai/privacy for details on what is processed and retained.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install and activate Beaconed.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Beaconed and connect your Beaconed account.
sections.faq:
Does Beaconed change my store without my approval?

Nope. Every optimization gets reviewed and approved in the Beaconed app before it touches your store. Auto-publish exists, but it’s strictly opt-in.

Do I need a Beaconed account?

Yes. Beaconed is a connector to the hosted Beaconed platform. Free credits are included so you can try it before subscribing.

Does Beaconed replace my SEO plugin?

No. Beaconed writes into your existing SEO plugin’s fields – it doesn’t replace Yoast, Rank Math, or whichever one you’re running. Think of it as the part of your SEO work that’s built specifically for how AI shopping agents actually read a product page.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, Squirrly SEO, The SEO Framework, and SmartCrawl.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0 – 2026-06-12

  • Initial release.
  • Connect a WooCommerce store to the hosted Beaconed platform with a one-click handshake and scoped, revocable API key.
  • Bulk-optimize the full product catalog, including stores with product variations; failing products are skipped and reported, never abort the run.
  • Review queue for AI-generated optimizations with approve/reject and automatic write-back to products, including alt text.
  • Failures after approval are reported back to Beaconed so optimizations never appear stuck.
  • Heartbeat connection monitoring that never delays admin pages when the Beaconed API is unreachable.
  • Clean uninstall: removes all plugin data, scheduled events, and the network-level key on multisite, with server-side key revocation.
  • Accessible Review app with translation loading.
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 10.8.

screenshots.caption: The connected dashboard — see how many optimizations are waiting to review and kick off a catalog optimization pass in one click.
The review queue — approve or reject each AI suggestion with a side-by-side view of your current live value and the suggested rewrite, plus a per-product AI readiness score.
Full control — every title, description, and meta field waits in the queue for your approval; auto-publish is strictly opt-in, never the default.
What gets optimized — product titles, descriptions, SEO title and meta description, Schema.org structured data, and image alt text, so each product climbs from invisible to AI-ready.
